title: AI needs to reduce its water dependency
authority_note: ESG research analysis; figures attributed to Goldman Sachs, IDC, WRI Aqueduct, Data Centre Map.
claims: US hosts ~39% of global data centres: 2,928 in the US of 7,597 globally (3,168 in North America)
US average electricity-generation water intensity 2.18 L/kWh (2015); wind/solar could cut US withdrawals ~25%
Goldman Sachs: ~$1tn AI-related capex in coming years; IDC: $632B global AI spending by 2028
Some forecasts: US data-centre power consumption doubling to 35 GW by end of decade
Less than one-third of data-centre operators tracked water metrics
WRI Aqueduct water-stress scores by country (US 2.6 Medium-High; China 2.8; India 4.1 Extremely High)
draft_usage: Cited for AI water dependency and US data-centre water-stress exposure under Energy.
issues: The draft's '~32% of US data centers in high/extremely high water-stress areas' is not explicitly stated in the fetched text; the article provides per-country DC counts + WRI Aqueduct categories from which such a figure would be derived.
